scope: Visible seed vocabulary only; excludes hidden readings, form supports, dictionary reference inventories and composite sentences. Existing classifications are counted as stored, not independently reclassified.

selection.reason: Four missing high-utility action predicates; movement and emotional expression expand reusable subject-verb practice.
Four missing adjective predicates; two contrast pairs expand descriptions and comparison, especially sparse Japanese adjective coverage.

illustrationPolicy: Actions use directly observable poses. Weight uses lifting effort and box contents. Difficulty uses explicit task context; pictures are examples of a selected sense and do not prove universal ease or difficulty. Reject mismatched puzzle geometry.

remainingGaps.approach: Check meanings and prior entries before adding; prefer repeated contextual scenes or examples over misleading single-event pictures.
Audit existing full sentences as well as lexical entries; use conversational roles and register notes.
Check kanji and kana lexical coverage and form audio; prioritize natural everyday clauses.
